boundaries.authority: Scoped local implementation and atomic commit; isolated temporary native stores only. No push, original capture mutation, unrelated staging, history rewrite or goal-complete update.

files.fact: Fresh serializer state for each column/granule; prefix/body/suffix; low_cardinality_max_dictionary_size=0 and specialized prefix/suffix streams.
No global dictionary body/suffix under the source-owned Compact max-zero/single-dictionary settings; additional-key index records are self-contained.
single_dictionary_for_part defaults true; the Compact writer leaves that default in place.
Per-mark LC dictionary maps are cleared.
Filename escaping applies to named Tuple components; a dot is %2E.
ArraySizes are per-row UInt64 deltas, not ULEB128.
Current strings are not zero-terminated; insertData stores exact payload bytes.
String-v0 writes varUInt(payload length) and payload; no trailing-NUL codec patch is warranted.

source_anchors.interpretation: Pinned primary source and native observations agree within this scope. The source checkout and native build are distinct revisions.

design.callback_owner: CompactBinaryBulkCallback is an own-file immutable event owner; prefix and dictionary-body callbacks may share a logical role but are distinct MRK4 slots.
design.encoded_owner: CompactEncodedColumn runs existing AdditionalKeysOnly encoder with one granule and one cumulative operation budget for LC-containing columns. Each dictionary stream must contain exactly one eight-byte version prefix with empty body. Stateless whole-grid encoding remains unchanged.
design.physical_owner: Existing one format-neutral assembler consumes callback_bytes for both sizing and assembly. MRK3 selects the first callback per column; MRK4 selects every event, including empty bodies and terminal pairs.
unchanged: Shared LC/String codecs and Wide dictionary policy
Reader grammar and whole-grid lifecycle preparation
Public writer API, sorted UInt64 key contract and default MRK3
Publication primitive, cumulative budget policy and existing refusal/profile gates
rejected_routes: Part-global LC dictionary policy or a whole-grid additional-key union is not the source-owned fresh Compact per-granule contract.
Do not collapse prefix and empty dictionary body to a single MRK4 slot.
Do not infer native semantic compatibility from CHECK=1 alone.
Do not change String payload semantics based on a stale trailing-NUL hypothesis.

behavioral_red.reason: Owned multi-granule LC positive encounters the previous LC refusal; earlier fixture/compiler preparation errors are not behavioral RED.

oracle_corrections.reason: Only expected named-Tuple escaped callback literals and 16-byte UInt64 ArraySizes zeros were wrong; corrected against pinned source, with no production change.

def inventory!(path, want)

def u64(bytes,p)
  raise "truncated u64" if p<0 || p>bytes.bytesize-8
  bytes.byteslice(p,8).unpack1("Q<")
end
def raw_and_frames(path)
  data=File.binread(File.join(path,"data.bin")); raw="".b; frames={}
  co=0
  while co<data.bytesize
    raise "frame header" if co>data.bytesize-25 || data.getbyte(co+16)!=0x82
    cs=data.byteslice(co+17,4).unpack1("V"); size=data.byteslice(co+21,4).unpack1("V")
    raise "frame bounds" if cs<9 || co+16+cs>data.bytesize || raw.bytesize+size>64*1024*1024
    input=data.byteslice(co+25,cs-9); output="".b; p=0
    while p<input.bytesize
      token=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; literals=token>>4
      if literals==15
        loop do
          raise "literal extension" if p>=input.bytesize
          n=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; literals+=n; break if n!=255
        end
      end
      raise "literal extent" if literals>input.bytesize-p
      output << input.byteslice(p,literals); p+=literals
      break if p==input.bytesize
      raise "match offset" if p>input.bytesize-2
      distance=input.byteslice(p,2).unpack1("v"); p+=2; count=(token&15)+4
      if (token&15)==15
        loop do
          raise "match extension" if p>=input.bytesize
          n=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; count+=n; break if n!=255
        end
      end
      raise "match extent" if distance.zero? || distance>output.bytesize || count>size-output.bytesize
      count.times { output << output.getbyte(output.bytesize-distance) }
    end
    raise "decoded frame size" unless output.bytesize==size
    frames[co]=[raw.bytesize,size]; raw << output; co+=16+cs
  end
  raise "frame EOF" unless co==data.bytesize
  [data,raw,frames]
end
def grid!(path, mode, slots, report, data, raw, frames)
  bytes=File.binread(File.join(path,"data.#{mode}")); width=16*slots+8
  raise "marks width" unless bytes.bytesize==width*5
  coords=[]
  5.times do |m|
    rows=u64(bytes,m*width+16*slots)
    raise "parent rows" unless rows==(m==4 ? 0 : 2)
    positions=Array.new(slots) do |slot|
      c=u64(bytes,m*width+16*slot); d=u64(bytes,m*width+16*slot+8)
      if m==4
        raise "EOF pair" unless c==data.bytesize && d.zero?
        pos=raw.bytesize
      else
        f=frames.fetch(c); raise "in-frame offset" unless d<=f[1]
        pos=f[0]+d
      end
      r=report.fetch("physical_mark_tape").fetch("records").fetch(m).fetch("pairs").fetch(slot)
      raise "reported pair mismatch" unless [r.fetch("compressed_offset"),r.fetch("decompressed_offset"),r.fetch("logical_position")]==[c,d,pos]
      pos
    end
    coords << positions
  end
  raise "nonmonotone marks" unless coords.flatten.each_cons(2).all?{|a,b|a<=b}
  coords
end
def lc_values(bytes, nullable)
  return [[],[]] if bytes.empty?
  flags=u64(bytes,0); raise "LC flags" unless (flags&0x700)==0x600 && (flags&~0x7ff).zero?
  width={0=>1,1=>2,2=>4,3=>8}.fetch(flags&255); n=u64(bytes,8); raise "LC dictionary bound" if n>4096
  cursor=16
  keys=Array.new(n) do |i|
    length=0; shift=0
    loop do
      raise "LC key varint" if cursor>=bytes.bytesize || shift>63
      b=bytes.getbyte(cursor); cursor+=1; length|=(b&127)<<shift
      break if (b&128).zero?
      shift+=7
    end
    raise "LC string extent" if length>bytes.bytesize-cursor
    value=bytes.byteslice(cursor,length); cursor+=length
    raise "LC null reserved key" if nullable && i.zero? && !value.empty?
    nullable && i.zero? ? "N" : "S:#{value.unpack1("H*")}"
  end
  count=u64(bytes,cursor); cursor+=8
  raise "LC index extent" unless count<=64 && cursor+count*width==bytes.bytesize
  values=Array.new(count) do
    ix=bytes.byteslice(cursor,width).unpack1({1=>"C",2=>"v",4=>"V",8=>"Q<"}.fetch(width)); cursor+=width
    keys.fetch(ix)
  end
  [keys,values]
end
